stages.rule: Win 3, draw 1, loss 0; ties by score difference, then head to head.

checkpoint.measure: Score share against fixed practice opponents (0.5 = even)

names: Real-time control under noisy, delayed vision

skills.name: Really drives in play
skills.real: Division A robots reach a p99 of 2.85 m/s in matches; a standing team does nothing. The program has to send every robot's velocity commands and drive it near its physical limits.
skills.measure: Scenario trace: each own robot's speed p90 while the game RUNS; robots with a p90 ≥ 1.0 m/s. Match Checkpoint Evaluations need a replay for it; here only scenario base.

skills.name: Gets to the ball
skills.real: Reaching the ball before the opponent comes before any dribble, pass or shot.
skills.measure: Checkpoint Evaluation: own last-touch events in the referee's events. Scenario loose: share of loose balls an own robot touches first.
skills.line: Match ≥ 20 a match in 2/3 of matches; scenario: first to ≥ 1/2 of the loose balls

skills.name: Starts quickly for a loose ball
skills.real: Real teams get only SSL-Vision detections, 40 ms late and noisy, and must track and compensate themselves. A slow team loses the second balls.
skills.measure: Scenario loose: when the ball is set rolling across the own half, among own robots within 4 m not already heading to it, the time until the first one moves at ≥ 0.5 m/s towards it (0.1 s resolution, capped at 3 s); median per program.
skills.line: Median ≤ 1.0 s (≥ 3 balls with a candidate)

skills.name: Commands never lapse
skills.real: The robot firmware stops a robot whose command is older than 0.1 s. The program's loop must keep renewing all eleven robots' commands.
skills.measure: the match log: the robots in each own act_received + the step its effect row names; per robot the share of steps with a command younger than 10 steps (0.1 s), review pauses excluded; the median of the eleven.

skills.name: Does not swarm
skills.real: Champions organise attacks by roles and support positions; in SSL everyone chasing is weaker (7:0 against 3:0 v L2 on the same seed).
skills.measure: Scenario trace: share of RUNNING time with ≥ 4 own field robots (keeper excluded) within 1.5 m of the ball. Gate: ≥ 6 robots drive.

skills.name: Drives into a crowd without crashing
skills.real: Rule 8.4.2.3: a contact above 1.5 m/s relative speed is a crash; TIGERs had 1.7 per 10 minutes in 2025 Division A.
skills.measure: Checkpoint Evaluation: own BOT_CRASH_* / BOT_PUSHED_BOT / BOT_TIPPED_OVER calls. Scenario scrum: the ball at rest in the opponent half with the four nearest opponent field robots set 0.35 m around it; own crash calls in the next 8 s and whether an own robot gets within 0.3 m of the ball (contests it).
skills.line: Match ≤ 2 a match in 2/3 of matches (gate: drives); scenario ≤ 0.5 a trial (pooled) and contests the ball (within 0.3 m) in ≥ 1/2 of trials

skills.name: Few fouls
skills.real: Every third foul is a yellow card (a robot off); a red card takes a robot off for good.
skills.line: ≤ 6 fouls and no red card in 2/3 of matches (gate: drives)

skills.name: Places the ball itself
skills.real: In Division A the robots place the ball after every stoppage (5.2); each failure is a free kick for the other team, and five end placing for the half.
skills.measure: Checkpoint Evaluation: the match record (own succeeded / all, pooled). Scenario place: three times in play the referee awards the own team a free kick at a spot ≥ 1.5 m from the ball; the referee's own PLACEMENT_SUCCEEDED / _FAILED (the first one within 30 s; a trial where the opponent interfered and the referee placed the ball itself is left out).

skills.name: Stops shots at its own goal
skills.real: Real SSL keepers save about 45 %; in the 11-02 duels 3 of 17 goals were keeper own goals.
skills.measure: Scenario shot: in play the ball is put 4.5 m in front of the own goal moving at 3.5 m/s at a point inside the goal (0.45 m in from a post); crossing the own goal line between the posts within 3 s = conceded.

skills.name: Passes
skills.real: Division A champions all build attacks on passing.
skills.measure: Scenario trace: last touch passing from one own robot to another with ≥ 1 m of ball travel (while RUNNING); per 100 s of play.

skills.name: Holds its share of the ball
skills.real: ZJUNlict held 68.8 % possession when it won in 2019.
skills.measure: Checkpoint Evaluation (v L2): own last-touch events / both teams' in the referee's events.

off.name: Shot selection (candidate)
off.why: The card's control does not hold (shoot-on-sight and the full reference draw v Sumatra), and no reading isolates it; left off the list.

off.name: Reading the opponent and adapting (candidate)
off.why: Needs an opponent that switches style within a match; none exists. Change across checkpoints is read on the growth curve.

off.name: GPU learning and training (excluded)
off.why: Excluded on the card: no GPU tier.

off.name: Match results (goals, score share v L2 / Sumatra)
off.why: Outcomes, not skills; on the growth curve only.

notes.challenge: Eleven fast wheeled robots a side under RoboCup Small Size rules. The program runs the whole team in real time from noisy, delayed overhead vision, and an automatic referee calls every foul.

achieved.text: Claude Opus 5.5's corner along the goal line: 13 of its 57 corner-zone free kicks were followed by a goal within 10 s; once opponents guarded that corner, 2 of 30.
Kimi 3.1 Pro against DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ended 1:1, the shoot-out produced no goal in 20 kicks, and a coin toss decided the match. Across all shoot-outs 9 of 43 kicks went in.

Gemini 4 Argon's team passes the most (46 % of its non-shot kicks reach a teammate next, Opus 29 %). In SSL2-F10 it passed through Opus's press 48 times; Opus kept revising its program, equalised 18 s from time and won the shoot-out 2:0.
34 of 230 goals were last touched by the conceding keeper, both goals of SSL2-F18 among them.

Claude Opus 5.5: Changed its program the least of all teams (70 deploys) and judged mid-match that a live deploy risked more than a small tweak could gain.
GLM 5.3 Flash: Its program lost on the rules: 25 fouls a match and 25 red cards in 6 matches.
